channel.title: Bylda Blog
channel.description: Writing on sales behavior, CRM data quality, deal risk, and revenue intelligence — why sales software keeps measuring the wrong thing.

item.title: CRM data vs sales behavior: what's the difference?
item.description: A CRM stores a summary someone typed after the fact. Behavioral data is what actually happened. The gap between them explains most of what goes wrong downstream.

item.title: How to identify a deal at risk before it stalls
item.description: Six behavioral signals that predict a stalled deal weeks before the close date moves — and what to do about each one.

item.title: Why sales forecasts fail when CRM data is stale
item.description: Forecast error is rarely a modelling problem. It is inherited from records authored by hand, days late, with a systematic optimism bias.

item.title: What an AI Sales Operating System actually is
item.description: CRM is a database. Conversation intelligence is a recorder. An AI Sales Operating System is the layer that does the work between them.

item.title: CRM adoption was never a training problem
item.description: Twenty years of enablement, required fields, and manager nagging have not fixed CRM data quality. The reason is simple: the problem was never behavioral.

item.title: Conversation intelligence is not the product
item.description: Recording and analyzing calls is now a commodity. The value was never in the insight — it was in whether anything happened next.

item.title: Five CRM automation workflows worth building
item.description: Most CRM automation projects automate the wrong half. Here are the five workflows that actually return time, and the order to build them in.

item.title: How to automate sales follow-ups
item.description: Automated follow-ups fail for one reason: they reference nothing. Here is how to automate the work while keeping every message specific.
